description: Maritzios wears a cream ankle-length tunic with a small slit neckline and narrow burgundy-and-gold woven borders at collar, cuffs and hem. A burgundy patterned long open-front coat has matching decorative borders along its front and short outer sleeves. Cream long inner sleeves reach the wrists. A broad dark decorated belt with round buckle and long metal-decorated tasseled hanging end encircles the waist. Loose dark trousers are tucked into tall brown leather-like boots. Cloth is substantial and opaque, with exact fibers uncertain. No headgear, armor, weapon or crown is visible.
